prods.name: BIO FRESH PURE HERBAL POWDER ( 1 BOTTLE)
prods.description: BIO FRESH Pure Herbal Deo Talc is a premium herbal talcum powder designed to keep your skin fresh, dry, and comfortable throughout the day. Its herbal formula helps absorb excess sweat, reduce body odour, and provide a long-lasting cooling sensation. The refreshing fragrance leaves you feeling clean and confident, making it ideal for everyday use.
